names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 29 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιος Ουαλερίνος», with the rank word left off. The same page gives «Ουαλεριανός» as an alternative in brackets and spells him «Οὐαλλερῖνος» in the couplet; the listing's form is the one kept here.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it prints no hymn and gives no year. The corpus already keeps a `valerius` on a venerated Greek 23 Απριλίου and several Valerians on other days; this man is a separate entry on a separate day and no identification between them is made here.
